biography: Gaston Garcia's journey began not on the asphalt, but amidst the vibrant chaos of Rio de Janeiro's favelas. His father, a mechanic with grease permanently etched under his fingernails, introduced him to the intoxicating scent of gasoline and the roar of engines. Gaston's first 'race' wasn't in a kart, but navigating the treacherous, pothole-ridden streets on his battered BMX, dodging stray dogs and reckless taxis. This early exposure instilled a fearlessness that would later define his racing style. At 16, he caught the eye of a local racing scout during an impromptu street race, leading to a scholarship with a regional karting team. His raw talent was undeniable, but his aggressive style often resulted in penalties. Now, at 21, Gaston is a rising star with Puma GTE, fighting to temper his aggression into calculated precision, a challenge he embraces with fiery determination. He is currently competing in the Brazilian GT series, showcasing flashes of brilliance that hint at a future on the international stage.
drivingStyle: Gaston's driving style is a volatile mix of raw aggression and surprising finesse. He attacks corners with unwavering commitment, often pushing the limits of grip to the absolute edge. While this boldness allows him to gain positions quickly, it can also lead to costly mistakes. He's learning to manage tire wear more effectively, but his innate instinct is always to push harder. Under pressure, Gaston thrives, displaying a remarkable ability to block out distractions and focus solely on the next apex, showcasing a mental fortitude that belies his age.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Vargas
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, fueled by Ricardo's accusations of Gaston's 'dirty' racing tactics.

rivalries.name: Isabela Monteiro
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle in the Brazilian GT series resulted in a controversial collision, leading to heated words and a promise of payback.

rivalries.name: Kenji Tanaka
rivalries.reason: Gaston feels Kenji is too conservative and predictable, believing his own aggressive style is what true racing is all about.

quirks: Always wears the same faded blue wristband his father gave him before every race.
Listens to a specific playlist of Brazilian funk music on repeat in the hour leading up to the race.
Refuses to start a race weekend without eating a 'pastel de nata' from his favorite bakery.
famousQuote: Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about taking risks and pushing yourself beyond your limits. If you're not on the edge, you're taking up space.
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Karting Championship in 2020 after starting from the back of the grid due to a mechanical issue in qualifying. He overtook 15 karts in a single race to claim victory.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of his debut Brazilian GT race in 2022, costing him a potential podium finish and severely damaging his team's car.
